steps.instructions: Phase 1/7 DISCOVER (repo-learn skill; the archetype skill's refs/modernize.md, its discover section): map the system being moved: its stack, entry points, data, integrations and the behaviours its users rely on, and read a prior domain map under .wicked/domain/ when there is one. Find the stack adapter the playbook's dispatch names for this move; when it names none, stop: say "no stack adapter for <from> -> <to>" and plan nothing further. GROUND FIRST: query the code graph through the wicked-garden-search skill and the read-only estate shim, one call per lookup: "$WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT/scripts/wicked-garden" run scripts/_estate_client.py --readonly call '{"tool":"SearchEntity","arguments":{"name":"<symbol>"}}' (always --readonly); then open and read every file you cite, at the lines you cite. Analysis only: write no files.

Phase 2/7 BLUEPRINT (solution architect; the archetype skill's refs/modernize.md, its blueprint section): the target design, where each old part goes, the behaviours to keep (each with the test that will show it), the cutover plan and how to roll back. Design only: write no source.

Phase 3/7 TRANSFORM (engineering skill; the archetype skill's refs/modernize.md, its transform section): build the new implementation beside the old one, following the blueprint, and keep the old path working until cutover. Never push, never open or edit a pull request — the run's deliver phase does that.
Phase 4/7 PARITY (migration engineer; the archetype skill's refs/modernize.md, its parity section): compare the old and the new path on the blueprint's behaviours.

Phase 5/7 CUTOVER (the archetype skill's refs/modernize.md, its cutover section): switch the callers, configuration and build to the new implementation as the blueprint's cutover plan says. Never push, never open or edit a pull request — the run's deliver phase does that.

Phase 6/7 CLEANUP (the archetype skill's refs/modernize.md, its cleanup section): remove the old path and anything only it used. Never push, never open or edit a pull request — the run's deliver phase does that.
Phase 7/7 PARITY ON THE FINAL TREE (migration engineer; the archetype skill's refs/modernize.md, its parity section): re-run the blueprint's behaviours on the tree that ships.
